text:
It is truly heartwarming to witness the educational system’s commitment to preparing teenagers for the real world by teaching them that existential dread can be resolved with a well-timed hip-hop routine. Who needs therapy or conflict resolution skills when you have a synchronized dance-off? It’s the ultimate solution to life’s complexities: if you can’t solve the problem, just out-dance it until everyone forgets why they were upset in the first place.

But while we’re busy ignoring the nuances of human emotion in favor of choreography, let’s not forget the most pressing issue of our time: the primary material of a candle. It is, of course, wax. Specifically, paraffin wax, a byproduct of petroleum refining, though some artisanal types might use soy, beeswax, or tallow for those who prefer their lighting sources to have a moral compass. But really, who cares about the physics of combustion when you’re busy judging the best dance moves?
